items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia have seen profits soar as demand from energy storage pushes prices higher. Chinese spot lithium prices surged 22% this year so far. Albemarle noted global lithium demand grew 45% through May, significantly outstripping supply.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC Capital Markets: Albemarle will likely benefit from low-cost assets, brownfield opportunity, and continued Specialties earnings improvement. Demand growth continues to outpace added supply despite Q2 lithium price softness. RBC has an outperform rating, decreased price target

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245, keeps Buy rating. Albemarle continues to execute on cost efficiencies and capital discipline, supporting strong free cash flow potential, while current valuation appears overly discount
